evidence.basis: AMC states that developers may access catalog APIs to display AMC showtimes and associated movie data. A user-owned catalog credential was live-verified during Phase 0; transaction endpoints are out of scope.
The two manualPick records are user-owned editorial records in this repository. Only those records, without Google URLs or provider-derived enrichment, are eligible for the iOS food catalog.
TMDB documents attribution for free non-commercial API use, but the iOS mission requires enrichment to remain disabled until the usage basis is explicitly cleared for this release.

evidence.basis: Places content has attribution and caching restrictions; results on a map must use Google Maps.
